listening.script: Hello, I would like to sign up for a swimming class at the sports centre. Sure. Classes run on Tuesdays and Thursdays at six in the evening. How much is it? It costs forty pounds for a month, or you can pay fifteen pounds for a single session. I will take the monthly option. Great. Please bring a towel and a swimming cap. The pool is closed on public holidays.

reading.title: Uyqu nima uchun muhim
reading.meta: True / False / Not Given · 4 ta savol
reading.text: Scientists have long known that sleep is essential, but recent studies show how deeply it affects daily life. Adults who sleep fewer than six hours a night are more likely to feel stressed and to make mistakes at work. A survey of 2,000 office workers found that those who slept seven to eight hours were twice as productive as colleagues who slept less. Some people believe that sleeping late at weekends can repair the damage of a short week, but researchers say this only helps partially. Experts recommend keeping regular bedtimes and avoiding screens for an hour before sleep.

items.q: Adults who sleep under six hours tend to feel more stressed.
items.exp: Matn: more likely to feel stressed. True.
Matn: A survey of 2,000 office workers. True.

items.q: Sleeping late at weekends fully repairs a short week.
items.exp: Matn: this only helps partially. False.

items.q: Doctors recommend drinking warm milk before bed.

speaking:
Describe a teacher who influenced you.
You should say: who this person was, what they taught you, how they behaved in class, and explain why they influenced you.

Describe a place in your city that you like to visit.
You should say: where it is, how often you go there, what you do there, and explain why you like it.

Describe a time when you helped someone.
You should say: who you helped, how you helped them, why they needed help, and how you felt afterwards.

Describe a useful app on your phone.
You should say: what it is, how often you use it, what it does, and explain why it is useful.

Describe a family celebration you remember well.
You should say: what the occasion was, who was there, what you did, and explain why you remember it.
